item.title: Water and Light Debt Gets an Income Test: What the New Payment-Plan Law Actually Changes
item.dc:creator: Rafael Ortiz Medina (avatar)
item.description: Law 235-2026 replaces the 50%-upfront payment-plan requirement LUMA Energy imposed. The arithmetic is now written into statute - 5% to 20% down, monthly payments capped at 5% of family income, and no interest on debts under $5,000.

item.title: Puerto Rico's 2027 Grocery Math: Thin Margins, Record Tariffs - and a SNAP Question Worth Asking Loudly
item.dc:creator: Rafael Ortiz Medina (avatar)
item.description: Puerto Rico imports about 90% of its food and its supermarkets run on 2.3% net margins. MIDA's Dec. 2 forum takes up the industry's biggest lever - a possible PAN-to-SNAP transition.
